body.text:
# busbar <VERSION> config, migrated by `busbar --migrate-config`.
# The items below need a decision; `busbar --validate` must pass.
# TODO(migrate): auth.chain: the static-token module is GONE in 1.5.0; every caller needs a minted signed key (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) - 1.x bearer tokens stop working
# TODO(migrate): auth.signing_key: required now that the chain uses `keys` (busbar no longer auto-generates one); run `busbar --generate-signing-key` and set auth.signing_key to a secret reference for it ({file: /path} or {env: VAR}, shared across a fleet)
# TODO(migrate): auth.client_tokens removed: static tokens are gone in 1.5.0; mint signed keys for each caller (POST /api/v1/admin/keys)

listen: 127.0.0.1:<PORT>
pools:
  claude-code:
    members:
    - weight: 1
      model: amazon-nova
  upstream_credentials: own
advanced:
  response_headers:
    server_timing: true
providers:
  bedrock:
    api_key:
      env: AWS_BEDROCK_CREDS
models:
  amazon-nova:
    provider: bedrock
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
    upstream_model: amazon.nova-pro-v1:0
auth:
  chain:
  - keys

effects.stderr:
migrated 'tests/migration-corpus/from-tags/v1.3.1_demo_config.yaml' to the 1.5.0 config shape. CHANGES (6): - auth.chain: tokens -> keys (static tokens removed; mint signed keys) - auth.client_tokens removed (static tokens are gone) - auth.upstream_credentials -> pools.upstream_credentials (the all-pools SCALAR default; override it per pool with `pools.

.upstream_credentials`) - observability.emit_server_timing -> advanced.response_headers.server_timing - pools.claude-code.members[].target -> model - providers.bedrock.api_key_env -> api_key: { env: ... } TODO (3) - a human must decide: * auth.chain: the static-token module is GONE in 1.5.0; every caller needs a minted signed key (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) - 1.x bearer tokens stop working * auth.signing_key: required now that the chain uses `keys` (busbar no longer auto-generates one); run `busbar --generate-signing-key` and set auth.signing_key to a secret reference for it ({file: /path} or {env: VAR}, shared across a fleet) * auth.client_tokens removed: static tokens are gone in 1.5.0; mint signed keys for each caller (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) Review the output, then run `busbar --validate` on it before deploying. NOTE: 1.x virtual keys do not carry over - mint fresh signed keys (the 1.5.0 security headline: keys now expire).
